extension.description: Attach to BEngine Editor in one click and use the engine's real C# project for IntelliSense.
trust.description: Debugging attaches to a local process and project synchronization asks the running editor to generate C# projects.
setting.timeout: Maximum time to wait for the running BEngine Editor to synchronize C# projects.
setting.justMyCode: Limit stepping to user code. Disable to step through packages when symbols are available.
